mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_history (user_id, session_id, question_text, question_context, answer_text, model_name, tokens_used, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{questionText}, #{questionContext}, #{answerText}, #{modelName}, #{tokensUsed}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tokens_used), 0) FROM ai_chat_history WHERE user_id = #{userId}
